title: Release notes by end of day tomorrow
transcript:
[00:00] Ingrid: Morning from Berlin. Quick one on the 4.2 release. The build is green and QA signed off last night.
[00:08] Marcus: Nice. Is the changelog still a mess?
[00:12] Ingrid: It's forty raw commit titles. Customers can't read that.
[00:16] Priya: Support wants the notes before the rollout so they can update the help center articles.
[00:23] Ingrid: Right. Marcus, can you get the release notes to me by end of day tomorrow? I'll review and publish them.
[00:32] Marcus: End of day tomorrow works. I'll group them by feature, fixes and deprecations.
[00:38] Priya: Please call out the export change. That one will generate tickets.
[00:43] Marcus: Will do. I'll put it at the top with a short how-to.
[00:49] Ingrid: And the rollout itself starts Thursday at 08:00 my time, ten percent first.
[00:55] Priya: I'll have the help center drafts ready to flip on Thursday.
[01:00] Marcus: Do we mention the API rate limit change or keep that for the developer newsletter?
[01:07] Ingrid: Mention it in one line and link to the developer docs.
[01:12] Priya: Works for me.
[01:16] Ingrid: Great. Thanks, both.
